Understanding a document
p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, instructions, form, or sign: Read it in your own language.
p.papier.private: The picture remains on your phone. Only the text that is read is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: The phone downloads its readable data (a few megabytes).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take the photo again, smoother and with more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Cannot start reading: Internet required for the first time. Try again when connected.
p.papier.e_read: Reading failed. Take the picture again.
p.papier.e_tr: Translation could not be performed (connection or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: For an important document (court, health, money, residence permit), check it with someone you trust or a community.
